optimized_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
        SUM(sr.SR_FEE) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM store_returns AS sr
    JOIN date_dim AS d
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk, sr.sr_store_sk
),
avg_returns AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ctr_store_sk,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id
FROM customer AS c
JOIN customer_total_return AS ctr1
    ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN store AS s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
   AND s.s_state = 'TN'
JOIN avg_returns AS ar
    ON ar.ctr_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > ar.ctr_total_return * 1.2
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 100
